deterministicPassConditions: keyword/path search returns ranked entries with non-zero score
draft or spec already names related code
deterministicFailConditions: requested path is outside the repository
boundaryAiConditions: deterministic search returns zero useful results
query uses domain language with no direct code keyword match
user or flow policy explicitly allows AI keyword selection
contextSearch.aiFallbackCondition: Use AI keyword selection only when deterministic search is insufficient and explicit opt-in or flow policy has allowed AI fallback.

deterministicPassConditions: Goal, Scope, Acceptance, Out of Scope, target path, and verification phrase are all present
request names concrete files or commands
static gates do not hit hard failure
deterministicFailConditions: no concrete goal can be derived
static hard gate rejects the request
boundaryAiConditions: research or multi-surface request has concrete deliverables but broad phrasing
autoCheck.aiFallbackCondition: Use AI scoring for boundary cases where rule-based scoring cannot decide buildability, ambiguity, verifiability, boundedness, target specificity, or precedent.
